body:
4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Rochdale AFC to host York City in League Two clash on November 14 (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC will welcome York City to the Crown Oil Arena on Saturday, November 14, as part of their Sky Bet League Two campaign. Tickets are available now.

Six vehicles seized during road safety operation in Rochdale (Rochdale). Police seized six vehicles, including an e-scooter, during a road safety operation in Rochdale, with multiple drivers reported for various offences.

New Ukrainian GCSE welcomed for Rochdale pupils (Rochdale). Rochdale MP Paul Waugh has welcomed plans for a Ukrainian GCSE, with teaching expected from September 2028 and first exams in 2029.

Cinderella panto set to enchant audiences at Middleton Arena this Christmas (Middleton). Panto-goers in Middleton will soon be treated to a magical rendition of Cinderella at Middleton Arena, starting December 20.

Weather: Cloudy 10°C in Rochdale today.
